summary: Iteration 6 – full regression sweep on both backend (28/28 pytest passed) and frontend (11/11 core flows on 390x844 mobile viewport). Backend covered: health (/api/), categories (12 incl. Video), plans (3m/6m/12m at 300/500/900€), auth register/login/me for admin +393331234567/Admin2026! (referral_code=MAESTRO-2026, is_admin=true), auth invalid-password path (401), 13+ seed articles across 10+ categories, view increment on article detail, 18 media items, meditation kind filter, SoundHelix meditation URLs regression (no Pixabay), premium-media 402 for free user, /search?q=medita, favorites toggle + list (returns {articles, media, ids}), comment POST/GET/DELETE, /completions + /certificate/{id}, /me/stats shape (articles_read/meditations/minutes/current_streak/longest_streak/badges), /referrals/me = MAESTRO-2026 + count, referral registration increments admin's count by 1, /billing/checkout {plan:12m} = 900€, LANCIO2026 coupon (auto-created via /admin/coupons {code, percent_off:20, max_uses:1000}) discounts 12m to 720€, admin article create+delete, ad create+list, broadcast message visible in /messages, admin stats summary/daily/top-content, admin users+orders, /register-push non-blocking with placeholder key. Frontend on mobile 390x844: login screen renders with correct testIDs (login-phone-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button); after login, Home shows global search that returns 'Risultati per medita' with 5 mixed cards (4 meditation + 1 disciplina orientale) — regression confirmed; Biblioteca grid shows articles with category chips (Tutte, Crescita personale, Spirituale, Filosofia…); Media tab renders 'Meditazioni & Video' with Tutti/Meditazioni/Video filter chips; Profilo shows Amministratore + PREMIUM + ADMIN badges, Lingua IT/EN toggle, Pannello Admin, Preferiti card, 📊 Il tuo percorso with '1 Articoli letti / 35 Min. meditati / 1 Giorni di fila' plus continuità hint, 🎁 referral code MAESTRO-2026 visible (testID=referral-code); Pannello Admin loads Statistiche with 14 Utenti/1 Premium/13 Articoli/18 Media/30 Viste totali + 3-day visualizzazioni chart + Articoli più letti top list; all 10 admin tabs found and clickable (stats/articles/media/youtube/ads/coupons/comments/messages/users/orders). No React Native red screen, no PAGEERROR, only harmless expo-notifications web warning. No deprecated Expo packages in repo (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports).
action_items: No regressions or bugs found — all iteration-1-through-5 functionality is intact and green.

Optional hardening (nice-to-have, not blocking): add explicit testIDs to bottom tab buttons (tab-home / tab-library / tab-media / tab-messages / tab-profile) so playwright can click via testID instead of URL navigation.
Optional: add testIDs to the three stat boxes on Profilo (stat-articles / stat-minutes / stat-streak) for stronger automated coverage.
Optional: add data-testid on meditation cards (med-card-<id>) so E2E can drive Media→Detail→AudioPlayer without relying on text lookup.

Env-dependent items intentionally skipped: real Emergent SuprSend push delivery, YouTube Data API v3 full-archive fetch, and Emergent Object Storage file upload — endpoints reachable and behave correctly with placeholder/RSS fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1420-1445 /billing/checkout correctly applies percent_off from coupon (900 → 720 for 20%) and returns amount_eur + original_eur — clean.
server.py:1352-1372 /admin/coupons validates percent_off with pydantic Field(ge=1, le=100) — proper input validation.
server.py:574-590 root /api/ + categories + plans do NOT require auth — good for boot health checks by frontend.
server.py:1244-1260 /register-push swallows relay errors and still stores device_token locally — non-blocking as expected.
server.py:1067-1078 media detail returns 402 for premium content when user is not premium — correct HTTP semantics.
server.py:1611-1660 Ads CRUD complete: create/list/toggle/delete + public /ads/active.
server.py file is 1678 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, content, admin, billing) in a future refactor, though not blocking.
No MongoDB _id leakage spotted in any response payload sampled during this run.
No deprecated Expo packages found in /app/frontend.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The 8 initial test failures were all test-script mismatches with the actual API contract (wrong field names in payloads and response paths); they were corrected in test_iteration6_regression.py and the final run is 28/28 green. No application code was modified.
